study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Young et al., Biological Psychiatry: Cognitive Neuroscience and Neuroimaging, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative Modeling of Thalamic Nuclear Volumes and Characterization of Lateralized Volume Alterations in Alzheimer's Disease Versus Schizophrenia

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study compared three predictive models: ordinary least squares regression (OLS), multiple fractional polynomial regression (MFP), and generalized additive models of location, shape, and scale (GAMLSS). The multivariate GAMLSS model with age, sex, eTIV, and site as covariates was selected as the top-performing model based on mean absolute error (MAE). The GAMLSS model uses cubic smoothing splines for age and models the mean (μ), standard deviation (σ), skew (ν), and kurtosis (τ) over a sinh-arcsinh distribution. Site was included as random effects.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: The multivariate GAMLSS model with age, sex, eTIV, and site as covariates was the overall top-performing model.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Young2024.pdf.md: Results / Normative Model Comparison and Evaluation

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study modeled volumes of 10 bilateral thalamic nuclei (anteroventral [AV], pulvinar [Pul], lateral geniculate nucleus [LGN], medial geniculate nucleus [MGN], medial dorsal-parafasicular [MD/Pf], centromedian [CM], ventral anterior [VA], ventral lateral anterior [VLa], ventral lateral posterior [VLp], and ventral posterolateral [VPL]) and the whole thalamus. Laterality indices (LI) were also computed for each nucleus as (VL - VR)/(VL + VR).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Volumes of 10 thalamic nuclei and the whole thalamus were generated for each hemisphere in addition to 2 extrathalamic structures (the habenula and the mammillothalamic tract). The 10 thalamic nuclei considered in this work are anteroventral (AV), pulvinar (Pul), lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN), medial geniculate nucleus (MGN), medial dorsal-parafasicular (MD/Pf), centromedian (CM), ventral anterior, ventral lateral anterior (VLa), ventral lateral posterior (VLp), and ventral posterolateral.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Young2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Thalamic Nuclei Segmentation

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: In the multivariate GAMLSS model, age was modeled with cubic smoothing splines (cs function), sex and eTIV (estimated total intracranial volume) were included as fixed covariates, and site was modeled as random effects. The model formula was: μ = cs(Age) + Sex + eTIV + random(Site), σ = cs(Age).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Generalized additive models of location shape and scale (GAMLSS) was implemented using the gamlss, cs, and random functions from the gamlss package in R... multivariate models used age, sex, TIV, and site as covariates
